q: I only have the audio of my podcast. How do I turn it into a YouTube video?
a: 1. Import the audio and a cover image (`file.import`). 2. Make a sequence at 1920 × 1080 (`sequence.settings`), put the audio on A1 and the image on V1, and stretch the image to the episode's length (trim its end out or set Speed / Duration, `clip.speedDuration`). 3. Clean up the voices once (Clean Up Voice, `audio.cleanupVoice`). 4. Add captions from the transcript (`transcript.createCaptions`) so the screen isn't static, and chapters from markers (`markers.addChapter`, `markers.exportCsv`). A slow push on the image (Motion Scale keyframes) adds a little life.

q: audio only episode, want some visuals so people dont click away
a: Options from least to most work: a slow Scale push on the cover image; big captions from the transcript (short `maxChars`, one line, `captions.setStyle`); a few B-roll stills or clips on V2 over key moments; title cards per topic from a template (`graphics.template.apply`). Keep the voice clean and at about −16 LUFS for a podcast, −14 for YouTube.

q: Two-host audio podcast to video: show which host is speaking with name cards.
a: With each host on their own channel or file (Breakout to Mono, `clip.breakoutToMono`, if they share one), find who talks where from the transcript. Place a name card graphic (a lower-third template with the name editable) while each host speaks, or swap two portrait stills on V2 at the speaker changes. Revolution has no automatic speaker-driven switching, so it's placed by hand; the transcript makes finding the changes quick.

q: Make a city drone shot look like a tiny toy model (tilt-shift).
a: 1. Duplicate the clip onto V2 and add Gaussian Blur to the copy (`effects.apply`). 2. Draw a rectangle mask on the copy's Opacity across the middle band (`masks.add`), Inverted and heavily feathered (`masks.set`), so the top and bottom are blurred and a sharp band stays in the middle. 3. Push saturation and contrast a little (toys are colourful). 4. Speed it up (Speed / Duration, `clip.speedDuration`, e.g. 300 %) or add Posterize Time for a stop-motion toy feel. High, steep camera angles sell it best.

q: miniature effect but the sharp area should follow a car
a: Same setup (blurred copy on V2 with an inverted, feathered mask), then track the mask on the car: Mask Path's track buttons (`masks.track`). Lost tracks on plain road can be fixed by hand with mask keyframes.

q: Tilt-shift in a comp so I can tweak the blur band as one graph.
a: Comp: Media In → Blur node, and the same Media In unblurred; a Mask node with the band shape on the sharp copy, merged over the blurred one (Merge), then a Color node for the saturated toy grade → Media Out. Feather the mask shape for a gradual focus fall-off.

q: punchy colourful travel video look without looking fake
a: Balance first (white balance and exposure on the first node), then on a look node: a little more contrast with an S-curve, Saturation up gently and watch it on the vectorscope; a bluer, deeper sky with a qualifier limited by a gradient window. In Lumetri, Vibrance raises the dull colours more than the already saturated ones, which keeps skin from going orange. Check skin on the skin line.

q: Make the turquoise sea pop in my beach clips.
a: On its own node, qualify the water (`grade.pickQualifier`), check the Matte view, then raise saturation and push the hue a touch towards cyan. Keep the sky and skin out of the matte with a window. Overdone sea colour clips on Rec. 709: let it roll off rather than saturating hard.

q: same vibrant grade on clips from my phone and my camera
a: Set each camera's input colour space (the phone's as Rec. 709) so both land in one working space, match the phone to the camera (less sharpening, softer contrast, matched skin), then copy the shared look node to every clip (`grade.append`).

q: My interview was recorded in an empty room and sounds echoey.
a: Type the clip Dialogue (`essentialSound.setType`) and raise Repair ▸ Reduce Reverb (a DeReverb) until the room shrinks but the voice still sounds natural; too much makes it watery. Then the usual order: rumble, noise, level, tone (EQ), loudness. Clean Up Voice sets a starting point but doesn't remove reverb, so add Reduce Reverb yourself.

q: reverb removal made the voice thin, can I get the body back
a: Lower Reduce Reverb a little, then use Clarity ▸ EQ with the Warm Voice or Balanced Voice preset to put body back; compare with the effect bypassed. A small amount of room is more natural than none.

q: Echoey voiceover plus a noisy fan, which first?
a: Noise first, then reverb: Reduce Rumble, then Reduce Noise (steady fan) or Voice Isolation, then Reduce Reverb, then dynamics and EQ. Each is an ordinary effect in Effect Controls, so you can reorder and bypass them to compare.

q: Everyone in the street freezes while I keep walking through them.
a: Shoot it locked off: the take where you walk through people who keep moving. 1. On V1, cut the take where the world should freeze (`sequence.addEdit`) and Frame Hold the part after it (`clip.frameHold`). 2. On V2, the same take (moving) with a mask around you on Opacity (`masks.add`), feathered and tracked as you walk (`masks.track`). 3. Where you pass in front of frozen people it works; where moving people cross you, the mask shows them moving, so stage the extras to stay still or out of your path.

q: freeze frame effect where only one person keeps moving
a: Frame Hold the shot on V1 (`clip.frameHold`), the live shot on V2 with a feathered mask around the moving person, tracked (`masks.track`). Locked-off camera only; anything moving inside the mask's edge will show.

q: Bullet-time style frozen moment with the camera moving around?
a: Not possible from one camera in Revolution: real bullet time needs many cameras or a 3-D scene, and the compositor has no 3D. What works: a frozen moment from a locked-off shot (Frame Hold + masked live layer), with a slow Scale / Position push on the hold to suggest camera movement.

q: I want to export a few frames from my video as photos for an Instagram carousel.
a: Park on each frame and Export Frame (`file.exportFrame`) as PNG (16-bit if you'll edit it further); pause first so the original, not a proxy, is used. Grade before exporting so the stills match the video. For a 4:5 crop, set a sequence at 1080 × 1350 and reposition each clip before exporting the frames.

q: the exported frame is blurry
a: Motion blur in the frame itself can't be removed: pick a frame where the subject is still. Make sure you're paused (Auto proxy mode shows the original when paused) and the sequence is at the footage's size; 6.2K originals give large stills.

q: Pull a sequence of 10 stills at regular intervals from a clip.
a: Add markers at the frames you want (`markers.add`), then go to each marker and Export Frame. It is one export per frame.

q: Fun 1-minute recap of my kid's birthday party.
a: 1. Selects: mark the best moments (candles, presents, laughing) with markers while watching once. 2. A sequence with an upbeat song fitted to a minute (Remix, `clip.remix.enable`); cut on its beats (`markers.add`, Snap). 3. Slow motion on the candle blow (Speed / Duration, Optical Flow). 4. A title with the name and age from a template. 5. A warm, bright grade copied across.

q: birthday video: keep the happy birthday singing audio but music everywhere else
a: Type the singing clip Dialogue and the song Music with Ducking against Dialogue (`essentialSound.generateDucking`), or cut the music out around the singing with short audio crossfades. Let the singing start under the previous shot (J-cut).

q: Freeze on the candle blow with confetti.
a: Insert Frame Hold Segment at the blow (`clip.insertFrameHoldSegment`), a confetti overlay clip on black above it with Screen blend, and a title. Revolution has no particle generator, so confetti comes from overlay footage.

q: Title fades in as my drone rises over the trees and reveals the lake.
a: 1. Mark the frame where the lake appears. 2. A title graphic on V2 starting there, Opacity keyed from 0 to 100 % over a second with eased keyframes (`effects.setInterpolation`). 3. A slow Scale push on the title (100 → 105 %) feels like it belongs to the move. 4. Swell the music at the same frame (a marker helps).

q: drone reveal shot is a bit shaky and too fast
a: Warp Stabilizer (Smooth Motion) for the shake, and slow it down with Speed / Duration (e.g. 50 %, Optical Flow for normal-frame-rate footage); drones that record 50–60 fps slow cleanly.

q: Match the drone footage colours to my main camera before the reveal.
a: Set the drone's own input colour space in colour management, tame its sharpening and saturation, then Shot Match it to a still of the main camera's grade and refine.

q: Circle and arrow annotations on a sports clip like a coach's breakdown.
a: Freeze the moment (`clip.insertFrameHoldSegment`) and add a graphic with shape layers: an ellipse around the player, a line or arrow for the run. Animate them on with Scale or Opacity keyframes (eased). Graphics hold text and shape layers, so draw with shapes; for a player who moves, attach the circle to a track (`tracking.attach`).

q: highlight one person in a crowd shot with a circle that follows them
a: An ellipse shape in a graphic on V2 placed on the person, then Attach to Track on its Motion (`tracking.attach`, Position only). Darken the rest a little with an inverted soft window if you want more focus.

q: Underline words on a document shot as I talk about them.
a: A thin rectangle shape layer under each word, its Scale X keyframed from 0 so it draws across (eased). If the paper moves, Corner Pin the graphic to the page with Track Surface (`tracking.cornerPin`).
